mapLocation.label: Talk to Kangai Mau at The Shrimp and Parrot restaurant in Brimhaven.

route.title: Walkthrough
steps: Talk to Kangai Mau in the Brimhaven food store. Dialogue: "I'm in search of adventure!", "Ok, I will get it back."
Travel to Ardougne (you can take a ship from Brimhaven to complete an easy Karamja Diary task), and head to the GPDT depot just south of the eastern bank.
Investigate the most north-eastern crate for the address label.
Use the label on the crate located 2 tiles to the south of the first crate.
Talk to a GPDT employee. Dialogue: "So, when are you going to deliver this crate?"

Talk to Wizard Cromperty in the house north-east of the Ardougne market with the checkered floor. Dialogue: "So what have you invented?", "Can I be teleported please?", "Yes, that sounds good. Teleport me!", or Dialogue: if you have completed the medium or higher Ardougne diaries.
Go west 2 doors and enter the password KURT. If you click too quickly it will say "This combination is incorrect", try again slower.
Right-click Investigate the stairs, requiring 21 Thieving, then climb them.
Search the chest on the top floor for the totem. You must finish the dialogue.
